headline: Signed motor vehicle excise warrants totaling over $5.8 million and reviewed new subdivisions.
summary: The board accepted minutes from the April 2, 2026 meeting. It signed the motor vehicle warrant to the Collector for commitments 2026-01 ($4,933,218.44), 2026-02 ($689,324.54), and 2025-08 ($200.00). The board also reviewed new subdivisions.
decisions: Accepted minutes of the April 2, 2026 meeting.
Signed motor vehicle warrant to Collector for commitment 2026-01 in the amount of $4,933,218.44.
Signed motor vehicle warrant to Collector for commitment 2026-02 in the amount of $689,324.54.
Signed motor vehicle warrant to Collector for commitment 2025-08 in the amount of $200.00.
